local cost = tonumber(ARGV[1])
local actor_limit = tonumber(ARGV[2])
local service_limit = tonumber(ARGV[3])
local window = tonumber(ARGV[4])
local maximum = tonumber(ARGV[5])

local function read_counter(key)
  local ttl = redis.call('PTTL', key)
  if ttl == -2 then return 0, ttl end
  local raw = redis.call('GET', key)
  local count = raw and tonumber(raw)
  if ttl < 0 or ttl > window or not count or count < 1 or count > maximum
    or count ~= math.floor(count) or raw ~= tostring(count) then
    return nil, ttl
  end
  return count, ttl
end

if KEYS[1] == KEYS[2] or not cost or cost < 1 or cost > 2 or cost ~= math.floor(cost)
  or not actor_limit or not service_limit or not window or not maximum
  or actor_limit < 2 or service_limit < 2 or actor_limit > maximum or service_limit > maximum then
  return redis.error_reply('invalid AI quota request')
end
local actor, actor_ttl = read_counter(KEYS[1])
local service, service_ttl = read_counter(KEYS[2])
if not actor or not service then
  return redis.error_reply('invalid AI quota state')
end

local retry = -1
if actor + cost > actor_limit then retry = math.max(retry, actor_ttl) end
if service + cost > service_limit then retry = math.max(retry, service_ttl) end
if retry >= 0 then return math.max(1, math.ceil(retry / 1000)) end

local function reserve(key, ttl)
  if ttl == -2 then
    redis.call('SET', key, tostring(cost), 'PX', window)
  else
    redis.call('INCRBY', key, cost)
  end
end
reserve(KEYS[1], actor_ttl)
reserve(KEYS[2], service_ttl)
return 0
